# {{ site.Title }}

> {{ site.Params.description }}

GitDiffGraph is a paid plugin for JetBrains Rider, sold on JetBrains Marketplace. It analyses C# solutions with Roslyn on the user's machine and records no telemetry. It is built by {{ site.Params.vendor }} ({{ site.Params.vendorUrl }}).
